<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

$MAXK = 1000000000000000000; // 1e18

// Precompute dp and total arrays
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$total = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

$dp[0] = 1;
$total[0] = 1;

for ($len = 1; $len <= $n; $len++) {
    $dp[$len] = 0;
    for ($l = 1; $l <= $len; $l++) {
        $ways = $total[$l - 1];
        $add = $ways * $dp[$len - $l];
        if ($add > $MAXK) $add = $MAXK + 1;
        $dp[$len] += $add;
        if ($dp[$len] > $MAXK) {
            $dp[$len] = $MAXK + 1;
            break;
        }
    }
    $total[$len] = $total[$len - 1] + $dp[$len];
    if ($total[$len] > $MAXK) $total[$len] = $MAXK + 1;
}

if ($k > $dp[$n]) $k = $dp[$n];

$result = [];
$remaining = $n;
$start = 1;

while ($remaining > 0) {
    // choose block length l
    $chosenL = 1;
    for ($l = 1; $l <= $remaining; $l++) {
        $ways = $total[$l - 1] * $dp[$remaining - $l];
        if ($ways > $MAXK) $ways = $MAXK + 1;
        if ($k > $ways) {
            $k -= $ways;
        } else {
            $chosenL = $l;
            break;
        }
    }

    $l = $chosenL;
    $blockStart = $start;
    $blockEnd = $start + $l - 1;

    // choose internal permutation of this block
    $blockSize = $l;
    $blockK = $k;
    $blockRes = [];

    while ($blockSize > 0) {
        $chosenLen = 1;
        for ($len = 1; $len <= $blockSize; $len++) {
            $ways = $total[$len - 1] * $dp[$blockSize - $len];
            if ($ways > $MAXK) $ways = $MAXK + 1;
            if ($blockK > $ways) {
                $blockK -= $ways;
            } else {
                $chosenLen = $len;
                break;
            }
        }

        $len = $chosenLen;
        $cycleStart = $blockEnd - $blockSize + 1;
        $cycleEnd = $cycleStart + $len - 1;

        $cycle = [];
        for ($v = $cycleEnd; $v >= $cycleStart; $v--) {
            $cycle[] = $v;
        }
        $blockRes = array_merge($blockRes, $cycle);

        $blockSize -= $len;
    }

    $result = array_merge($result, $blockRes);

    $k = $blockK;
    $start += $l;
    $remaining -= $l;
}

echo implode(' ', $result) . PHP_EOL;
?>

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);
$k = (int)$k;

$fact = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
    if ($fact[$i] > 1e18) $fact[$i] = (int)1e18 + 7;
}

$used = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$res = [];

function getUnused($used, $n) {
    $arr = [];
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if (!$used[$i]) $arr[] = $i;
    }
    return $arr;
}

function buildCycle($startIdx, $len, $unused, $used, $n) {
    // build cycle of length len, with maximum at first position
    // unused is sorted list of remaining numbers
    // choose maximum element as first
    $maxVal = max($unused);
    $cycle = [$maxVal];
    $used[$maxVal] = true;
    // remaining len-1 elements: smallest available
    $remain = [];
    foreach ($unused as $v) {
        if ($v == $maxVal) continue;
        $remain[] = $v;
    }
    sort($remain);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len - 1; $i++) {
        $cycle[] = $remain[$i];
        $used[$remain[$i]] = true;
    }
    // write cycle into permutation
    global $res;
    $pos = $startIdx;
    $cycleLen = count($cycle);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $cycleLen; $i++) {
        $from = $cycle[$i];
        $to = $cycle[($i + 1) % $cycleLen];
        $res[$from - 1] = $to;
    }
    return $used;
}

$pos = 1;
while ($pos <= $n) {
    $remaining = $n - $pos + 1;
    $maxLen = $remaining;
    $unused = getUnused($used, $n);
    rsort($unused);
    $maxVal = $unused[0];
    // cycle length cannot exceed position of maxVal in unused
    $idx = array_search($maxVal, array_reverse($unused));
    $maxLen = count($unused) - $idx;
    $len = 1;
    while ($len <= $maxLen) {
        $cnt = $fact[$remaining - $len];
        if ($cnt >= $k) break;
        $k -= $cnt;
        $len++;
    }
    $unused = getUnused($used, $n);
    $used = buildCycle($pos, $len, $unused, $used, $n);
    $pos += $len;
}

echo implode(' ', $res) . PHP_EOL;
?>

$MAXK = 1000000000000000000; // 1e18

// Precompute dp[i]: number of valid permutations of length i (capped at MAXK)
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $sum = 0;
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $i; $len++) {
        $add = $dp[$i - $len];
        $sum += $add;
        if ($sum > $MAXK) {
            $sum = $MAXK;
            break;
        }
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

if ($k > $dp[$n]) $k = $dp[$n];

$result = [];
$cur = 1;
$remaining = $n;

while ($remaining > 0) {
    // choose length of next block
    $chosenLen = 1;
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $remaining; $len++) {
        $cnt = $dp[$remaining - $len];
        if ($cnt >= $k) {
            $chosenLen = $len;
            break;
        } else {
            $k -= $cnt;
        }
    }

    // build block of length $chosenLen starting at $cur
    if ($chosenLen == 1) {
        $result[] = $cur;
    } else {
        // first element is max in block: $cur + $chosenLen - 1
        $result[] = $cur + $chosenLen - 1;
        // remaining elements are increasing from $cur to $cur + $chosenLen - 2
        for ($x = $cur; $x <= $cur + $chosenLen - 2; $x++) {
            $result[] = $x;
        }
    }

    $cur += $chosenLen;
    $remaining -= $chosenLen;
}

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

$MAXK = 1000000000000000000; // 1e18

// Precompute dp[i]: number of valid permutations of length i
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $sum = 0;
    // block size 1
    $sum += $dp[$i - 1];
    if ($sum > $MAXK) $sum = $MAXK;
    // block size >=2 (even length)
    for ($len = 2; $len <= $i; $len += 2) {
        $sum += $dp[$i - $len];
        if ($sum > $MAXK) {
            $sum = $MAXK;
            break;
        }
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

function solve($n, $k, $dp, $MAXK) {
    $res = [];
    $cur = 1;
    while ($cur <= $n) {
        $remaining = $n - $cur + 1;
        // try block size 1
        $cnt1 = $dp[$remaining - 1];
        if ($cnt1 >= $k) {
            $res[] = $cur;
            $cur++;
            continue;
        }
        $k -= $cnt1;
        // try larger even block sizes
        $chosenLen = 0;
        for ($len = 2; $len <= $remaining; $len += 2) {
            $cnt = $dp[$remaining - $len];
            if ($cnt >= $k) {
                $chosenLen = $len;
                break;
            }
            $k -= $cnt;
        }
        if ($chosenLen == 0) $chosenLen = 2; // fallback, though shouldn't happen
        // build block of size chosenLen: pattern [cur+1, cur+2, ..., cur+len-1, cur]
        for ($i = 1; $i < $chosenLen; $i++) {
            $res[] = $cur + $i;
        }
        $res[] = $cur;
        $cur += $chosenLen;
    }
    return $res;
}

$ans = solve($n, $k, $dp, $MAXK);
echo implode(' ', $ans) . PHP_EOL;
?>

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

$MAXK = 1000000000000000000; // 1e18

// Precompute dp[i] = number of valid permutations of length i
// dp[0] = 1
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $sum = 0;
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $i; $len++) {
        if ($len == 1) {
            $ways = 1;
        } elseif ($len == 2) {
            $ways = 1;
        } else {
            $ways = 2;
        }
        $add = $ways * $dp[$i - $len];
        $sum += $add;
        if ($sum > $MAXK) {
            $sum = $MAXK;
            break;
        }
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

if ($k > $dp[$n]) $k = $dp[$n];

$result = [];
$cur = 1;

function add_block($start, $len, $type, &$result) {
    if ($len == 1) {
        $result[] = $start;
    } elseif ($len == 2) {
        if ($type == 0) {
            $result[] = $start;
            $result[] = $start + 1;
        } else {
            $result[] = $start + 1;
            $result[] = $start;
        }
    } else {
        if ($type == 0) {
            $result[] = $start + $len - 1;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $len - 1; $i++) {
                $result[] = $start + $i;
            }
        } else {
            $result[] = $start + $len - 1;
            $result[] = $start + $len - 2;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $len - 2; $i++) {
                $result[] = $start + $i;
            }
        }
    }
}

while ($cur <= $n) {
    $remaining = $n - ($cur - 1);
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $remaining; $len++) {
        if ($len == 1) {
            $ways = 1;
        } elseif ($len == 2) {
            $ways = 1;
        } else {
            $ways = 2;
        }
        $block_total = $ways * $dp[$remaining - $len];
        if ($block_total >= $k) {
            if ($len == 1) {
                add_block($cur, $len, 0, $result);
            } elseif ($len == 2) {
                add_block($cur, $len, 0, $result);
            } else {
                $half = $dp[$remaining - $len];
                if ($k <= $half) {
                    add_block($cur, $len, 0, $result);
                } else {
                    $k -= $half;
                    add_block($cur, $len, 1, $result);
                }
            }
            $cur += $len;
            break;
        } else {
            $k -= $block_total;
        }
    }
}

echo implode(' ', $result) . PHP_EOL;
?>

$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

    $sum = 0;
    // block size 1
    $sum += $dp[$i - 1];
    if ($sum > $MAXK) $sum = $MAXK;
    // block size 2
    if ($i >= 2) {
        $sum += $dp[$i - 2];
        if ($sum > $MAXK) $sum = $MAXK;
    }
    // block size >=3
    if ($i >= 3) {
        $add = 0;
        $limit = $i;
        for ($len = 3; $len <= $limit; $len++) {
            $add += $dp[$i - $len];
            if ($add > $MAXK) {
                $add = $MAXK;
                break;
            }
        }
        $sum += $add;
        if ($sum > $MAXK) $sum = $MAXK;
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

// Build permutation
$res = [];
$pos = 1;
while ($pos <= $n) {
    $remaining = $n - $pos + 1;

    // Try block size 1
    $cnt1 = $dp[$remaining - 1];
    if ($cnt1 >= $k) {
        $res[] = $pos;
        $pos++;
        continue;
    }
    $k -= $cnt1;

    // Try block size 2
    if ($remaining >= 2) {
        $cnt2 = $dp[$remaining - 2];
        if ($cnt2 >= $k) {
            $res[] = $pos + 1;
            $res[] = $pos;
            $pos += 2;
            continue;
        }
        $k -= $cnt2;
    }

    // Block size >=3
    $len = 3;
    while (true) {
        if ($len > $remaining) break;
        $cnt = $dp[$remaining - $len];
        if ($cnt >= $k) break;
        $k -= $cnt;
        $len++;
    }

    // Build block of size $len starting at $pos
    // We need (pos+len-1, ..., pos+1, pos) with max first
    $block = [];
    for ($i = $len - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
        $block[] = $pos + $i;
    }
    foreach ($block as $v) $res[] = $v;
    $pos += $len;
}

echo implode(' ', $res) . PHP_EOL;
?>

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

$maxN = $n;
$dp = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxN; $i++) {
    $sum = 0;
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $i; $len++) {
        $sum += $dp[$i - $len];
        if ($sum > 1e18) {
            $sum = 1e18;
            break;
        }
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

function build($n, $k, $dp) {
    $res = [];
    $cur = 1;
    while ($cur <= $n) {
        $rem = $n - $cur + 1;
        $chosenLen = 1;
        for ($len = 1; $len <= $rem; $len++) {
            $cnt = $dp[$rem - $len];
            if ($cnt >= $k) {
                $chosenLen = $len;
                break;
            } else {
                $k -= $cnt;
            }
        }
        $block = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $chosenLen; $i++) {
            $block[] = $cur + $i;
        }
        $block[0] = $cur + $chosenLen - 1;
        for ($i = 1; $i < $chosenLen; $i++) {
            $block[$i] = $cur + $i - 1;
        }
        foreach ($block as $v) $res[] = $v;
        $cur += $chosenLen;
    }
    return $res;
}

$perm = build($n, $k, $dp);
echo implode(' ', $perm) . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

$MAXK = 1000000000000000000; // 1e18

// Precompute dp[i]: number of valid permutations of length i
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
$dp[0] = 1;
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $sum = 0;
    // block size s
    for ($s = 1; $s <= $i; $s++) {
        if ($s == 1) {
            $add = $dp[$i - 1]; // single fixed point
        } else {
            // block of size s: one fixed point + (s-1)-cycle
            $add = $dp[$i - $s];
        }
        $sum += $add;
        if ($sum > $MAXK) {
            $sum = $MAXK;
            break;
        }
    }
    $dp[$i] = $sum;
}

function solve($n, $k, $dp, $MAXK) {
    $res = [];
    $current = 1;
    while ($current <= $n) {
        $remaining = $n - $current + 1;
        $chosenBlockSize = 1;

        for ($s = 1; $s <= $remaining; $s++) {
            if ($s == 1) {
                $cnt = $dp[$remaining - 1];
            } else {
                $cnt = $dp[$remaining - $s];
            }
            if ($cnt >= $k) {
                $chosenBlockSize = $s;
                break;
            } else {
                $k -= $cnt;
            }
        }

        if ($chosenBlockSize == 1) {
            $res[] = $current;
            $current++;
        } else {
            // Build block: [current, current+1, ..., current+chosenBlockSize-1]
            $block = [];
            for ($i = 0; $i < $chosenBlockSize; $i++) {
                $block[] = $current + $i;
            }
            // standard cycle: largest first, then descending
            rsort($block);
            foreach ($block as $v) {
                $res[] = $v;
            }
            $current += $chosenBlockSize;
        }
    }
    return $res;
}

$ans = solve($n, $k, $dp, $MAXK);
echo implode(' ', $ans) . PHP_EOL;
?>

A cycle is a sequence of numbers such that each element of this sequence is being mapped into the next element of this sequence (and the last element of the cycle is being mapped into the first element of the cycle). The cyclic representation is a representation of p as a collection of cycles forming p. For example, permutation p = [4, 1, 6, 2, 5, 3] has a cyclic representation that looks like (142)(36)(5) because 1 is replaced by 4, 4 is replaced by 2, 2 is replaced by 1, 3 and 6 are swapped, and 5 remains in place.
